title: Adaptive config stress testing and slice-aware rollback orchestration for microbatch + KV-cache
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Build an automated stress-testing + slice-aware rollback orchestration that can safely evaluate candidate batching + KV-prefetch configurations against production-like traffic slices and drive safe automated rollouts or immediate rollbacks when leading indicators cross defined safety thresholds.

Scope: this ticket implements the experiment runner, metric set, dashboard panels, and an automated rollback playbook for canary/cohort trials of microbatch and cache priming policies. Deliverables:
- Traffic slice definitions (cohort selectors by route, model, and token distribution) and sample selection pipeline.
- Experiment runner: parallelizable job that stages config variants to a small cohort, collects telemetry for N minutes/requests, and computes pre-specified metrics and statistical comparisons.
- Safety circuit & rollback orchestrator: a policy engine that decides immediate rollback when safety gates breach, and recommends roll-forward when metrics look good.
- Dashboard: Grafana panels for slice-level cost, latency, quality (approx), and divergence plots; summary card with pass/fail.

Primary metrics we will emit and evaluate per cohort:
- Econ: tokens_per_second_served, cost_per_1M_tokens_est (model compute estimate), baseline_cost_delta_pct
- Latency: p50, p95, p99, tail_latency_above_500ms_count
- Reliability: error_rate (500/502/timeout), retry_rate, dropped_requests_count
- Quality proxies: rerank_consistency_score_delta, repetition_rate_delta, sampling_divergence_score (KL-ish proxy), and a small set of golden prompts QA-score (manual eval placeholder)
- Safety: cache_miss_rate, kv_prefetch_eviction_rate, memory_pressure_events

Hypothesis testing & decision rules:
- Use cohort-level sequential testing with a minimum observation window of 15 minutes or 10k requests (whichever first).
- Primary pass criteria: (1) econ_improvement >= 8% AND (2) p95_latency change <= +10% AND (3) error_rate_change <= +0.2 percentage points AND (4) quality_proxy_delta <= -1.5% (where negative is degradation).
- Immediate rollback triggers: error_rate_change > +0.5pp OR p99_latency increase > +30% OR cache_eviction_spike > 3x baseline OR any customer-facing incident reported.
- Uncertainty handling: if pass criteria met but p-value > 0.1 for econ_improvement, mark as "inconclusive" and expand cohort rather than roll forward.

Design trade-offs considered:
- Short windows reduce time to value but increase false positives due to noise; we bias toward conservative safety rules for any cohort with >50% enterprise traffic.
- We prioritize econ improvements for non-critical background routes (embeddings, async batch jobs) for more aggressive batching, while chat/dialog routes default to stricter safety gates.

Operational artifacts and links:
- Experiment runner design doc (Confluence): https://redwood.atl/confluence/display/INF/Adaptive+Config+Stress+Testing
- Prototype runner PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runner/pull/672
- Initial Grafana dashboard (dev): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/exp_batch_cache/Adaptive-Experiments (panel IDs included in doc)
- Canary orchestration playbook (runbook): https://redwood.atl/confluence/display/OPS/Batch+Cache+Canary+Playbook

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Implement cohort selector & sample extraction job (2 days)
2) Wire experiment runner to deploy candidate configs to canary mesh and collect telemetry (5 days)
3) Implement metric calculators + sequential test harness (3 days)
4) Build Grafana panels and a pass/fail summary endpoint (2 days)
5) Integrate rollback orchestrator with deployment platform and add Slack + Pager alerting per playbook (2 days)
6) Pilot with low-risk routes (embeddings, rerank) for 2 weeks; iterate thresholds and dashboards (ongoing)

Success criteria (for pilot):
- Pilot reduces unit compute cost by >=6% on selected routes with no customer-facing incidents and regression of quality proxies within threshold.
- Automated rollback triggers have <2 false positives per month once thresholds tuned.

Open questions / Next steps required for completion:
- Finalize which exact quality proxies to use for chat routes (we currently use rerank_consistency_score and golden prompt set; PM review requested).
- Decide conservative econ threshold for enterprise cohorts (suggest >=10% improvement before roll-forward).
- Confirm SLO ownership for new metrics (who will own quality_proxy_signal).

Notes on privacy and security: this system will emit aggregate telemetry only and will not persist raw user prompts. KMS/RBAC controls apply per normal telemetry pipelines; security review requested on rollout orchestration since it can trigger automated config changes.
